purpose: Test whether an organism-specific learned actuator model improves held-out action selection at states where the correct action depends on the organism's own dynamics.

policies.self_model: estimate organism-specific gain g_hat from training transitions; for each held-out state choose the action maximizing predicted reward
policies.reactive: fixed state-only threshold: choose action 1 if e<4.475, otherwise 0; no learned dynamics
policies.damaged_self_model: same learned policy but replace g_hat with registered generic gain 1.00

metrics.primary: held-out action-selection accuracy against oracle-optimal action
metrics.prediction_rmse: one-step prediction RMSE on held-out transitions

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only the registered operational property that an organism-specific model of its own action-state dynamics improves held-out control/action selection and that damaging that model removes the advantage. It does not establish consciousness, subjective self-awareness, general self-knowledge, intelligence, or universality.
